extra.final_summary: The data had three main issues: (1) Category labels had inconsistent spacing and case (e.g., 'Office Supplies ' and ' Furniture'), which were normalized to standard forms. (2) Region had misspellings ('Nort', 'Suoth', 'Wst') that were corrected to 'North', 'South', 'West'. (3) The 'Price' column contained a dollar sign ('$40.00') which was converted to a numeric value. One 'Region' value was missing and set to null. All other checks passed. The total revenue by category is: Accessories $1,785, Electronics $25,150, Furniture $10,045, Office Supplies $456.
